object.attr: High-accuracy location at 1 s intervals drains the battery, and runners judge the app by how long a long run can be recorded. Measured on the reference device, a Sony Xperia XQ-DE54, with no other app in use, using the per-app figure in the Android battery usage statistics. Owner decision, 2026-10-31. Basis: owner decision.
object.description: While the screen is off in the recording state, the app shall limit battery consumption to 5 % of battery capacity per hour, averaged over a 60 min session.
